about: Problems in public/student-questions.json found during the concept pilot. Reported here; the catalog itself has not been changed. Page fixes the pipeline applies are in content-supplements.json. All found by AI reviewers (Claude; GPT-6 where noted), not confirmed by a human.

The page header reads 2002 AP Chemistry Form B Question 3, not 2011.
Catalog page 2091 prints Questions 23-25 (OCR read '23.' as '21.'); printed Question 21 is on page 2089. Supplement applied.

572 records have a primaryUnit that is null or disagrees with primaryTopic.
OCR text interleaves two page columns and includes another question's text; printed Question 38 is about spectrophotometry. Reported by GPT-6; confirmed by Claude from the catalog text.
Printed (i)/(ii) subparts under (a)-(d) are grouped in the catalog's part list. Reported by GPT-6.
The catalog groups (c) onward; the page separately asks (c)(i)/(ii) and (d)(i)/(ii). Reported by GPT-6; consistent with the blind adjudicator's part split.
The catalog fullText is a one-line paraphrase, not the printed question text. Found by Claude during the GPT-6 analysis.

Not a typo in the question number: this is a different exam form from the released 2024 FRQs (released Q5, HI equilibrium, is frq-2024-5-476 on bank-02 p176). The bank-08 set (frq-2024-1-2111 … frq-2024-7-2127 and the MCQs from compiled page 2079) is a scanned physical exam booklet with no year or form code on the examined pages; the year comes only from the uploader's title on a document-sharing cover page (bank-07 p278). Layout fits the 2014–2024 format. Most likely an unreleased 2024 form (international or alternate), unconfirmed. Record not changed. Details: docs/concept-classification/source-identity-frq-2024-5-2125.md.

bank-08 p28 (compiled page 2128) is the cover of a separate shared document titled "Unit 1 Progress Check MCQ" and p59 is headed "Unit 3 Progress Check: MCQ" (AP Classroom), yet the 28 catalog records on compiled pages 2129–2159 are labelled as 2024 exam MCQs (mcq-2024-*). Only those two pages were inspected. Found by Claude while checking frq-2024-5-2125; records not changed.

frq-2024-1-480, frq-2024-3-480 and frq-2024-5-480 are numbered procedure steps inside released 2024 FRQ 7 (bank-02 p180), parsed as separate questions. Found by Claude from the catalog text; records not changed.
Two further 'frq-2024-*' sets (bank-02 p184–198 and the 'Version J' set on p201–212) use A/B part labels, which suggests the post-2024 exam format. Not verified; flagged for a check.
